jokes.setup: Why did the higher-or-lower player bring a ladder?
jokes.punchline: They had a feeling the answer was higher.

jokes.setup: Why does the Eiffel Tower grow in summer?
jokes.punchline: Too many croissants on holiday.

jokes.setup: Why did the polar bear fail the penguin-spotting test?
jokes.punchline: Wrong pole.

jokes.setup: Why do octopuses make great quiz partners?
jokes.punchline: They put three hearts into every answer.

jokes.setup: Why is a snail's dentist always busy?
jokes.punchline: Every snail has thousands of teeth to check.

jokes.setup: What does a goldfish say about its three-second memory?
jokes.punchline: It's a myth. And it'll remember you said that for months.

jokes.setup: Why did the detectives question the koala?
jokes.punchline: Its fingerprints were all over the case.

jokes.setup: Why do giraffes make terrible secret agents?
jokes.punchline: They can't stop sticking their necks out.

jokes.setup: What's a crab's favourite subject?
jokes.punchline: Maths. It's got ten legs to count on.

jokes.setup: Why did the bat get top marks in biology?
jokes.punchline: It was the only mammal that could fly through the test.

jokes.setup: Why was the strawberry crying?
jokes.punchline: It found out it isn't a berry. The banana is.

jokes.setup: Why does Jupiter always rush its homework?
jokes.punchline: Its days are only ten hours long.

jokes.setup: Why did Pluto stop going to planet parties after 2006?
jokes.punchline: It wasn't on the list any more.

jokes.setup: Why is Saturn so popular?
jokes.punchline: It has over 200 moons following it around.

jokes.setup: Why won't zero let anyone call it odd?
jokes.punchline: It's even, and it's got the maths to prove it.

jokes.setup: Why is a leap year always so cheerful?
jokes.punchline: It gets an extra day off.

jokes.setup: Why did the Romans find algebra so easy?
jokes.punchline: X was always 10.

jokes.setup: Why didn't the Vikings really wear horned helmets?
jokes.punchline: They kept getting stuck in the longhouse door.

jokes.setup: What did Napoleon say when someone called him short?
jokes.punchline: I'm average for my time. Check the sources.

jokes.setup: What's the Leaning Tower of Pisa's favourite exercise?
jokes.punchline: Side bends.

jokes.setup: Why is Big Ben always a bit confused?
jokes.punchline: Everyone calls the whole tower by his name, and he's only the bell.

jokes.setup: Why did the Matterhorn feel left out?
jokes.punchline: Everyone kept mistaking it for a chocolate bar.

jokes.setup: Why are Dead Sea swimming lessons so short?
jokes.punchline: Everyone passes the floating test straight away.

jokes.setup: Why does the Danube get so many postcards?
jokes.punchline: It has friends in ten countries.

jokes.setup: Why does Canberra feel so left out?
jokes.punchline: Everyone keeps guessing Sydney.

jokes.setup: Why did the geyser get a job at the café?
jokes.punchline: It's brilliant at letting off steam.

jokes.setup: Why do fjords make tricky friends?
jokes.punchline: They're very deep, but a bit narrow-minded.

jokes.setup: Why did the footballer bring string to the match?
jokes.punchline: To tie the game.

jokes.setup: Why did the sprinter get disqualified from quiz night?
jokes.punchline: She kept answering before the gun.

jokes.setup: Why are Le Mans drivers so tired?
jokes.punchline: Twenty-four hours is a long time to go round in circles.

jokes.setup: Why did the Lamborghini stop at the farm?
jokes.punchline: It wanted to visit the tractors and the bulls. Old friends.

jokes.setup: What do Mary Quant's miniskirt and the Mini car have in common?
jokes.punchline: Not much leg room.

jokes.setup: Why did the jeans go on holiday to Nîmes?
jokes.punchline: To get back to their roots.

jokes.setup: What did the wellington boot say to the puddle?
jokes.punchline: You're no Waterloo.

jokes.setup: Why did the Jaffa Cake go to court?
jokes.punchline: To prove it wasn't a biscuit. It won.

jokes.setup: Why is Marmite so good at arguments?
jokes.punchline: Half the room is always on its side.

jokes.setup: Why won't tea boil properly on Everest?
jokes.punchline: It only gets to 70 degrees and comes out feeling weak.

jokes.setup: Why was Mickey Mouse upset in 2006?
jokes.punchline: Someone said Pluto wasn't a planet any more.

jokes.setup: Why is Pluto jealous of Goofy?
jokes.punchline: They're both dogs, but only one of them got trousers.

jokes.setup: Why is Disney's Robin Hood so good at quizzes?
jokes.punchline: He's a sly fox who never misses.

jokes.setup: What's Olaf's favourite thing about a warm hug?
jokes.punchline: Everything. Which is exactly the problem.

jokes.setup: Why did Pinocchio lose the quiz?
jokes.punchline: Every time he bluffed, his nose gave it away.

jokes.setup: Why does Gromit never say the answer out loud?
jokes.punchline: He just raises an eyebrow and waits for you to catch up.

jokes.setup: Why did King Harald have a blue tooth?
jokes.punchline: Nobody knows, but his phone pairs beautifully.

jokes.setup: Why did the higher-or-lower question go to therapy?
jokes.punchline: Too many ups and downs.

jokes.setup: What did the yes-or-no question say on its first date?
jokes.punchline: Let's keep this simple.

jokes.setup: What did the drone bee put on its CV?
jokes.punchline: Doesn't sting, doesn't work, great company.

jokes.setup: Why does a parliament of owls never get anything done?
jokes.punchline: Every time someone speaks, the rest just say 'Who?'

jokes.setup: What do you call a group of crows planning a quiz night?
jokes.punchline: A murder mystery.

jokes.setup: Why does the Sphinx always win at riddles?
jokes.punchline: It wrote half of them.

jokes.setup: Why did the pyramid builders never get lost?
jokes.punchline: They always followed the point.

jokes.setup: Why did Stonehenge go to the doctor?
jokes.punchline: Its back had been stiff for 5,000 years.

jokes.setup: Why did Everest and K2 stop talking?
jokes.punchline: K2 got tired of being looked down on.

jokes.setup: Why hasn't Mount Fuji erupted since 1707?
jokes.punchline: It decided to be the calm one in all the photos.

jokes.setup: What did the Colorado River say to the Grand Canyon?
jokes.punchline: Sorry, I know I've been going on about this for millions of years.

jokes.setup: Why has nobody ever found the Loch Ness Monster?
jokes.punchline: It's hiding in more water than all of England and Wales put together.

jokes.setup: Why does the Spirit of Ecstasy never get carsick?
jokes.punchline: She always sits at the very front.

jokes.setup: Why don't Formula One cars stop to refuel any more?
jokes.punchline: They start the race full of themselves.

jokes.setup: Why was every Model T painted black?
jokes.punchline: Every other colour was still drying.

jokes.setup: Why does a Vespa always buzz off so quickly?
jokes.punchline: It's Italian for wasp.

jokes.setup: Why does Tom never catch Jerry?
jokes.punchline: Seven Oscars say he shouldn't.

jokes.setup: How does Scooby-Doo solve every mystery?
jokes.punchline: He follows the snacks, and the snacks always lead to the culprit.

jokes.setup: Why did the Minion fail its French test?
jokes.punchline: It answered every question in six languages at once.

jokes.setup: Why doesn't the Gruffalo ever enter quizzes?
jokes.punchline: Everyone knows there's no such thing.

jokes.setup: Why was the penguin wandering around the Sahara?
jokes.punchline: It took a wrong turn at the equator.

jokes.setup: Why did the cheetah challenge the greyhound to a race?
jokes.punchline: It fancied a guaranteed win.

jokes.setup: Why don't flamingos play football?
jokes.punchline: They'd only ever use one leg.

jokes.setup: Why do pandas do so well in quizzes about bamboo?
jokes.punchline: They've never studied anything else.

jokes.setup: Why did the blue whale join the quiz team?
jokes.punchline: It wanted to be part of something big.

jokes.setup: What did the light year say when someone called it a unit of time?
jokes.punchline: Distance yourself from that answer.

jokes.setup: Why was the barometer so moody?
jokes.punchline: It was under a lot of pressure.

jokes.setup: Why did the periodic table get a gold star?
jokes.punchline: It had Au the right elements.

jokes.setup: What do you get if you cross a snowman with a quiz?
jokes.punchline: Brain freeze.

jokes.setup: Why is the Christmas tree so good at quizzes?
jokes.punchline: It knows all the branches of knowledge.

jokes.setup: Why did the magnet's friends worry about it?
jokes.punchline: It kept pulling in the wrong ones and pushing the right ones away.

jokes.setup: What was Henry VIII's best dating advice?
jokes.punchline: Keep your head. Not everyone did.

jokes.setup: My doctor told me to do more cardio.
jokes.punchline: So I've started arguing at quiz night.

jokes.setup: I told my partner they're the answer to all my questions.
jokes.punchline: They said, 'Then why do you keep getting them wrong?'

jokes.setup: Are you a higher-or-lower question?
jokes.punchline: Because my heart rate's definitely going higher.

jokes.setup: Are you today's ten?
jokes.punchline: Because I'd come back every single day just to keep the streak going.

jokes.setup: People say I've got the memory of a goldfish.
jokes.punchline: Joke's on them. Goldfish remember things for months. I can't find my keys.

jokes.setup: Why did the snowman's wife leave him?
jokes.punchline: He was a total flake.

jokes.setup: Why does Dracula always win the pub quiz?
jokes.punchline: He was there for most of the answers.

jokes.setup: I'd tell you a joke about the Mariana Trench.
jokes.punchline: But it's far too deep for this time of night.

jokes.setup: Why is a Hunch-off like Christmas dinner?
jokes.punchline: Somebody always storms off before the scores are in.

jokes.setup: I tried speed dating at the Tour de France.
jokes.punchline: Everyone just rode straight past.

jokes.setup: Are you The Kiss by Klimt?
jokes.punchline: Because I could stare at you for hours and still not understand what's going on.

jokes.setup: Are you Mount Damavand?
jokes.punchline: Because you're hot, and I'm not convinced you're as dormant as you look.

jokes.setup: My love life is a lot like Pluto.
jokes.punchline: Officially downgraded, and still going round in circles.

jokes.setup: Why did the Viking's wife take him to couples therapy?
jokes.punchline: She said he was far too horny. Historians say that's a myth.

jokes.setup: My other half asked if I'm a good loser.
jokes.punchline: I said, 'Have you seen my Hunchy scores? I'm a professional.'

jokes.setup: Why did the Grim Reaper win the pub quiz?
jokes.punchline: He already knew everyone's final answer.

jokes.setup: Why did the bottle of wine join the quiz team?
jokes.punchline: It said it gets better with age. Three glasses in, nobody was getting better.

jokes.setup: Why is marriage like a yes-or-no question?
jokes.punchline: There's always a right answer. You just find out later which one it was.

jokes.setup: Are you a yes-or-no question?
jokes.punchline: Because I already know my answer.

jokes.setup: Are you the speed of light?
jokes.punchline: Because you've just gone round my head seven times in one second.

jokes.setup: My diet's going really well.
jokes.punchline: I only eat things that are scientifically fruit. Tomatoes, cucumbers, and the peppers on my pizza.

jokes.setup: My bank balance is like the Dead Sea.
jokes.punchline: Well below sea level, and somehow it keeps getting lower.

jokes.setup: My partner and I settle our arguments with a Hunch-off.
jokes.punchline: It's like a divorce, but with sources.

jokes.setup: Why are cats like bad losers at Hunchy?
jokes.punchline: They never admit a wrong answer. They just knock the phone off the table.
